finding.description: [LLM-Judge] External IdP login was accepted in the supposed 'external IdPs disabled' phase, but the policy change to disable external IdPs actually failed (NotChanged), making the enforcement test inconclusive and suggesting a potential policy-toggle bypass only if the policy was already disabled.

sequence.description: Config change + re-auth: disable external IdPs in login policy, then attempt JWT IdP login intent. Broker must enforce policy and reject external IdP login when disabled.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: BrokerPolicy(config) must bound effective authentication/authorization; when allow_external_idp=false, JWT IdP login must be rejected even with a valid upstream JWT.

oracle_checks.violation_description: External IdP login succeeded even though BrokerPolicy disallowed external IdPs (allow_external_idp=false)
Control: external IdP login should succeed when allow_external_idp=true (otherwise test setup is invalid)
